candidates.title: Renters United Philadelphia Monthly Meeting (Zoom)
candidates.venue: Philadelphia, Philadelphia, Pe
candidates.description:
OnePA Renters United Philadelphia is a citywide renters union with a mission to organize and educate renters to fight for our rights to quality housing in the streets, in the courts, and in City Hall.
Join us for our monthly meeting online on zoom to get the backing of our community to stand with you in fighting for the housing you deserve, and to learn how you can take action to support our campaign to win Safe Healthy Homes from City Council this year!

candidates.title: Rox Crit
candidates.venue: Roxborough, Philadelphia, PA
candidates.description:
Rox Crit provides the opportunity for artists to receive and give critique in a supportive setting. The goal of this monthly neighborhood artist critique group is to nourish each artist's unique practice, generate challenging creative conversations, and build community. Led by Roxborough-based painter and sculptor Dana O'Malley. All levels welcome, with a focus on practicing artists who are looking to invigorate or restart their practice and gain creative community.

candidates.description:
The 2026 Anne Sallee Greenwood Lecture Discovery Series will celebrate the simultaneous permanent collection reinstallations at Crystal Bridges Museum of American Art (CBMAA) and the Pennsylvania Academy of Fine Arts (PAFA).
Curators from PAFA and CBMAA will be in dialogue about what it means to reinterpret historical American art collections in 2026, the semi-quincentennial anniversary of the United States.
